Select the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate molregno, then join to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join to molecule_dictionary to get the substrate compound name. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to parent_molregno and then to molecule_dictionary to retrieve the parent compound name. Return the columns canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Limit to 200 rows.
